name: Before / After Image Slider
summary: Interactive matched-media comparison that composes the canonical native Slider as its sole value, focus, form, pointer, touch, and keyboard owner.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native figure and Slider root for one matched-media comparison.

anatomy.name: stage
anatomy.description: Positioning stage that also composes the canonical Slider track.

anatomy.name: mediaFrame
anatomy.description: Shared clipped frame for both matched media layers.

anatomy.name: overlay
anatomy.description: Logical-progress clip that reveals the second matched media layer.

anatomy.name: afterMedia
anatomy.description: Second comparison media layer revealed by the native range value.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.description: Canonical native range owner with fixed 0–100 bounds and step 1.

anatomy.name: controlLabel
anatomy.description: Localized accessible name for the native range input.

anatomy.name: divider
anatomy.description: Decorative divider synchronized to the canonical Slider progress variable.

anatomy.name: beforeLabel
anatomy.description: Optional visible label for the base state.

anatomy.name: afterLabel
anatomy.description: Optional visible label for the revealed state.

anatomy.name: description
anatomy.description: Optional figure caption referenced by the native range input.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic responsive media stage with a canonical touch-sized Slider thumb.

states.name: default
states.description: Authored value is reflected in the reveal, divider, and native input.

states.name: enhanced
states.description: Canonical Slider synchronization is active and the native input is operable.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Canonical Slider focus indication on the sole native control.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Unavailable native control while the comparison remains perceivable.

states.name: noEnhancement
states.description: Static authored reveal with the unsynchronized native input hidden.

states.name: rightToLeft
states.description: Reveal origin and divider alignment follow logical inline direction.

behavior.name: requiredComposition
behavior.description: A non-empty localized label plus both matched media slots are required; omit the complete root when any is absent.

behavior.name: canonicalSliderOwnership
behavior.description: One canonical native Slider input is the sole value, focus, form, reset, pointer, touch, keyboard, and event owner.

behavior.name: progressSynchronization
behavior.description: Canonical Slider synchronization writes one private progress variable consumed by the logical clip and decorative divider.

behavior.name: controlledUncontrolled
behavior.description: Static HTML uses the native value as an uncontrolled default; framework targets control that same native owner and consume native events without mirrored state.

behavior.name: progressiveEnhancement
behavior.description: Without shared runtime, the authored reveal remains visible and the native input stays hidden so control and artwork cannot diverge.

behavior.name: logicalDirection
behavior.description: The reveal advances from logical inline start and preserves native range keyboard behavior in the active writing direction.

behavior.name: mediaSemantics
behavior.description: Targets supply matched framing and useful distinct alternatives or an equivalent shared description without redundant announcements.

behavior.name: boundedRuntime
behavior.description: The component adds no animation, polling, network work, per-frame JavaScript, pointer-capture engine, or layout-read loop.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Required localized accessible name describing what percentage the control reveals.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Optional visible comparison description referenced by the input.

properties.name: beforeMedia
properties.description: Required target-owned base media with matched framing.

properties.name: afterMedia
properties.description: Required target-owned revealed media of the same subject and framing.

properties.name: beforeLabel
properties.description: Optional visible label for the base state.

properties.name: afterLabel
properties.description: Optional visible label for the revealed state.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current reveal percentage, clamped to the fixed 0–100 comparison scale.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Makes the native comparison control unavailable without hiding its content.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Optional native form-field name for the reveal percentage.

accessibility: Use one native input type="range" as the only focusable comparison control.
Provide a required localized label that explains the revealed percentage; a generic Before and After name is insufficient.
Preserve native minimum 0, maximum 100, step 1, current value, pointer, touch, keyboard, form, and reset semantics.
Supply matched media with useful distinct alternatives or an equivalent concise shared comparison description.
Keep visible before and after state labels optional and supplementary; do not rely on image position or color alone.
Keep the divider decorative and expose visible keyboard focus only through the canonical native Slider thumb.
No component motion is introduced, so reduced-motion mode preserves the same operation.

web.notes: Composes canonical Slider markup and shared synchronization from components/js/theme.js; S17 adds only comparison presentation.
